overview: Black copies with 1...b5. White plays 2.Bb2 Bb7 3.a3 or e3 with symmetrical play, each side fianchettoing and neither achieving much. Quiet manoeuvring in a flank structure.

white_ideas.idea: Seek an edge in the symmetrical structure

character.notes: Mirror-image b-pawns and fianchettoed bishops; quiet manoeuvring with small edges.

gambit.notes: No material is given up on purpose.

soundness.notes: Sound; neither side can easily exploit the symmetry.

structure.notes: Neither side has played a central pawn move, so the centre is undecided.

approach.notes: Seldom chosen by strong players; the Polish is a surprise weapon.

level.notes: Little theory, though no obvious plan either.

character.reason: Symmetrical and quiet, neither solid nor sharp.

plans.reason: Mirror-image pawns with bishops on the long diagonal.
